load_model_ensemble: load fairseq model ensemble, task, generator, and dataset iterator from checkpoint path
generate_completions: generate text completions from model using beam search or top-k/top-p sampling with configurable prefix length
eval_single_token_prediction: evaluate single-token prediction accuracy, MLE loss, perplexity, and ranking metrics on a dataset iterator
batch_input_sequence_by_prefix_length: batch input sequences by dividing them into fixed-length prefix chunks for generation
run_eval_pipeline: run full evaluation pipeline loading model, generating completions, and computing perplexity and ranking metrics
